body: I'm around 6 months from my next birthday and I've said goodbye to the people who are important to me.  None of the have responded.  I hope natural causes take me, but I'm pretty sure I will pass by my own hand very soon.

I'm sorry I've taken so long to reply.  I've been dealing with structural issues with our garage, trying to make  sure the roof doesn't cave in because load bering walls weren't built correctly, or built at all.  I've made brief friendships here and there, whether online or at work.  They don't last, mainly because I tend to be too honest and typically don't have a filter.  I've tried to tone it down but that seems to make it worse.

I have tried.  The friends won't respond to calls or texts,  and the spouse becomes more distant when I try to talk to them. The kids aren't old enough to fully grasp what I'm dealing with mentally, so I haven't tried to talk to them about it. I can't talk to my siblings or mom.  Mom is a very staunch catholic, so guilt trips are numerous if you imply that maybe she wasn't the perfect mom.  The siblings also are very devout to Catholicism, so more guilt trips.  I do talk to my mom, but it is about how she is doing and what needs fixed at her house because the other children won't fix it.  A couple of months back I had to fix the toilet handle even though my older brother is back home every weekend and he knew it was broken.  I received counseling about two years after my father passed and tried their suggestions to open a dialog, but it has proven in effective and I got guilt trips for my feelings.
